items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I … Tokisho or something. I didn‟t know he was doing that purposely.

ctx.x: I … Tokisho or something. I didn‟t know he was doing that purposely. You were supposed to give him money. I didn‟t know that. Gene Cherico told me, so I said, “Okay,” so, and after that everything was okay.

[Laughs] Well, I wanted to ask you about, you know, you said that while you were in Boston you got a chance to play with people because they were on extended engagements. You said you played with Miles and Max Roach. What were those experiences like?
